lines.21: They say gossip only lasts seventy-five days.
lines.24: 「Gah... You people never stop teasing me.」
lines.27: 「They only keep doing it because your reactions are so funny. You need to build up an immunity already.」
lines.29: 「You're going to walk the same road as me, aren't you?」
lines.31: 「All right! Let's walk together until you're immune!」
lines.35: 「That's just going to make me even more enemies.」
lines.38: All right, then. Time for me to brace myself, too.
lines.45: She tightened her grip around my arm.
lines.46: The Princess gleefully dragged me all over the school.
lines.47: Yep. She's a bully after all.
lines.49: That's the price of being in love, I guess.
lines.50: 「This really feels like youth, doesn't it?」
